subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this draft stay open as the combined Telegram proof target until Mantis actually exercises the generated-media marker path, or should maintainers retire it in favor of the split PRs?
rationale: The branch is intentionally proof-only and combines two open landing boundaries, while the available Mantis artifact skipped both sides; automation cannot decide whether that proof gap is acceptable or whether the combined stack should ever land.

options.title: Keep As Proof Target
options.body: Keep this draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, live output, or logs show baseline missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one generated image.

options.title: Land Only Split PRs
options.body: Use this branch for proof capture only and merge the implementation and proof harness separately through their own PRs.

options.title: Retire The Stack
options.body: Close this draft if maintainers no longer want a combined proof target or if the proof runner cannot exercise the scenario.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof Target
recommendation.body: Keep this draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, live output, or logs show baseline missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one generated image.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is mainly about the Telegram proof runner, proof artifact path, and agent delivery boundary where vincentkoc has recent directly relevant history.
